behavioral.label: Node onClick (graph node / agent shard selection)
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls setSel(n.id) (local state) and onSelect?.(n.id) (prop callback). Both are pure UI selection — no backend call needed. Inspector panel renders immediately from the agents prop already in scope.

behavioral.label: Node onKeyDown (keyboard nav: Enter / Space to select shard)
behavioral.evidence: Mirrors onClick — calls setSel + onSelect on Enter/Space; e.preventDefault() prevents scroll on Space. Correct.

visual.issue: Progress bar uses literal Tailwind classes `from-violet-400 to-emerald-400` instead of design-token classes. These bypass the theme layer and will not adapt to light/dark or brand token changes.

Legend uses `bg-cyan-400` for Planning and `bg-emerald-400` for Validated as Tailwind utility classes. The SVG nodes resolve the same phases through `viz.cyan400` (#22d3ee) and the brass CSS var, but the Legend diverges — `bg-emerald-400` has no counterpart in visualTokens, so Legend color for Validated is inconsistent with the actual node stroke color (`viz.emerald400` is not defined; node uses a fallback).
SVG edge base-stroke is a bare `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` literal. Should use a CSS-var-based token for dark/light theme correctness.
`viz.cyan400` is a hex literal (#22d3ee) baked into an SVG linearGradient stop. The value matches the Tailwind `cyan-400` swatch but is not a CSS variable, so it ignores theme overrides.
`viz.white` (#ffffff) is a hardcoded hex used as the radial gradient inner stop for the root node glow. Breaks on non-dark backgrounds.

The outer `<svg>` has no `role`, `aria-label`, or `title` element. Screen readers encounter an unlabelled SVG containing interactive buttons. Should add `role='img'` with `aria-label='Agent topology graph'` or wrap nodes in a `role='group'` with a caption.

SVG `<g>` nodes have `role='button'` and `tabIndex={0}` which is correct, but there is no visible focus ring defined via CSS for the SVG context — only `focus-visible:[outline:...]` on the group element; SVG groups do not reliably display CSS outlines in all browsers. A `<rect>` or `<circle>` with stroke as a focus indicator would be more robust.

AgentInspector panel has no `role='dialog'` or `aria-live` region. When a node is selected the panel appears absolutely positioned but focus is not moved to it, and screen readers receive no announcement. Add `aria-live='polite'` or move focus into the panel on selection.

AgentInspector is positioned `absolute right-5 top-5 w-72`. At narrow viewport widths (<320px) it can overflow the parent container. The parent Glass uses `overflow-hidden` which clips it silently rather than reflowing.

Header uses `<h2>` with hardcoded copy 'Mind-Map · Agent Shards' but the surface navLabel in the registry is 'Agents'. The heading copy is inconsistent with nav labelling, breaking information scent for users navigating by headings.

SVG viewBox is hardcoded to `1200 × 640`. The containing div is `h-[600px]` (bracket value). These are not responsive — no ResizeObserver or viewBox scaling from container dimensions. At narrow widths the SVG shrinks via `preserveAspectRatio` but nodes become too small to read.
`h-[600px]` bracket Tailwind value for the SVG wrapper height is hardcoded. Should use a responsive or CSS-var-driven height.
